sections.Profile:
"Tag-Team Pinball" is a pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in September 1985, featuring a wrestling theme. The game has three flippers, no ramps, and a three-ball multiball mode. Designed by John Trudeau with artwork by Larry Day, it is part of the Gottlieb System 80B series, with a production run of 1,220 units.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1985–1986
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
